format: Studio/Custom custom-entry formats (Showcase, Spotlight, Routine, Student pair, Showdance, Cabaret, Theatre Arts, Choreographed routine)
requirement: Studio/Custom formats are DanceFlow formats: names, descriptions, wizard copy and review text read 'Studio/Custom: ...', carry no governing-body name, and never imply certification, approval or rule compliance. Persisted format ids are unchanged.
enforcement_point: TypeScript display layer applied in the setup wizard page and in deriveDraft (the seeded profile studio_simple@3 is immutable). Known gap: contest names persisted by public.create_competition_draft come from the immutable SQL profile and are not changed (see interpretation_notes).

tests.name: custom formats read as DanceFlow Studio/Custom and imply no governing-body rule or certification
persisted ids and every non-display field are unchanged (before/after snapshot)
keeps the flexible Studio/Custom participant-role behavior

interpretation_notes: Wizard and review copy are relabelled. The category name written into event_competition_contests.name for NEW setups is built inside public.create_competition_draft from the profile row (v_cat_def->>'label'), so it still carries the legacy label (for example 'Student/Student — American Smooth'). Changing it needs a separately reviewed migration (for example profile studio_simple@4 and a function change) or render-time mapping at every read site via configuration.simple.category_type; neither is done here. Marked unverified, not verified_compliant, until the owner decides that gap.
